sourceText: I think you’ve been twirling around that stick a bit too much.
targetText: Sa tingin ko, masyado mong iniikot ang patpat na iyon.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: , let’s try to follow that <style=Important>train of thought</style> again, shall we?
targetText: , subukan nating sundan muli ang <style=Important>daloy ng pag-iisip</style>, sige?

sourceText: …it’s as you both said, I tried to get us all out with my hammer, but I failed.
targetText: …gaya ng sinabi ninyong dalawa, sinubukan kong ilabas tayong lahat gamit ang martilyo ko, pero nabigo ako.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I gave the shelf one big whack and the handle ripped right off.
targetText: Hinampas ko nang malakas ang estante at agad na naputol ang hawakan.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I figured it was no big deal and tried to hide it, but I suppose my embarrassment got the better of me.
targetText: Akala ko hindi iyon malaking bagay at sinubukan kong itago, pero nanaig yata ang hiya ko.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(She does look genuinely sorry about the situation.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Mukhang taos-puso siyang humihingi ng tawad sa sitwasyon.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I never expected your hammer to snap like that, Amy.
targetText: Hindi ko inaasahang mapuputol nang ganoon ang martilyo mo, Amy.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: It was one of my backups… it’s a little lighter to carry around. I didn’t think I’d need it!
targetText: Isa iyon sa mga extra ko… mas magaan itong dalhin. Hindi ko akalaing kakailanganin ko!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Well lucky for you, I’m a detective and I dabble as a mechanic! Let me see both pieces of the hammer.
targetText: Mabuti na lang para sa iyo, detektib ako at paminsan-minsan ding nagmemekaniko! Ipakita mo sa akin ang dalawang bahagi ng martilyo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Just tighten things here, a little elbow grease there… and fixed!
targetText: Higpitan lang ito rito, kaunting puwersa roon… at ayos na!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Tails…! Thank you!
targetText: Tails…! Salamat!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: According to my calculations, if you hit the shelf riiiiiight… here! It should do the trick.
targetText: Ayon sa kalkulasyon ko, kung hahampasin mo ang estante nang diiiiiito mismo! Gagana iyan.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Alright, stand back!
targetText: Sige, umatras kayo!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: We did it, we’re free!
targetText: Nagawa natin, malaya na tayo!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Great job Amy! Let’s get out of here.
targetText: Magaling, Amy! Umalis na tayo rito.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Sadly, it’s empty.
targetText: Sa kasamaang-palad, walang laman.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: But on the bright side, this is a very clean trash bin!
targetText: Pero ang maganda naman, napakalinis ng basurahang ito!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(...how do I become as optimistic as this kid?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(...paano ako magiging kasing-optimistiko ng batang ito?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Ah, the wet floor sign, keeping people alert and safe!
targetText: Ah, ang karatulang babala sa basang sahig—pinananatili nitong alerto at ligtas ang mga tao!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Once I slipped on some spilled juice at the grocery store, no wet floor sign at all!
targetText: Minsan, nadulas ako sa natapong juice sa grocery store—wala man lang karatulang babala sa basang sahig!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Luckily Sonic was there to catch me.
targetText: Mabuti na lang, naroon si Sonic para saluhin ako.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Wow, Sonic really is as fast as they say.
targetText: Wow, talagang kasingbilis si Sonic ng sabi nila.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: …but he was going so fast he also slipped on the juice.
targetText: …pero sa sobrang bilis niya, nadulas din siya sa juice.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: We slid into an older gentleman’s shopping cart.
targetText: Dumulas kami papunta sa shopping cart ng isang matandang ginoo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: I wonder how this side of the shelf got smashed?
targetText: Nagtataka ako kung paano nagkapira-piraso ang bahaging ito ng estante.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: There’s nothing the shelf could have fallen into, and I’m sure this damage wasn’t here before. The train has too much upkeep.
targetText: Walang bagay na maaaring bagsakan ng estante, at sigurado akong wala pa rito ang pinsalang ito. Napakahusay ng pagmamantini sa tren.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: …I feel like this is important. We should log it.
targetText: …Pakiramdam ko, mahalaga ito. Itala natin.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: I think we've found enough clues.
targetText: Sa tingin ko, nakakita na tayo ng sapat na clue.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Let's go <style=Important>interrogate</style> Amy and find out what really happened!
targetText: <style=Important>Interogahin</style> natin si Amy at alamin kung ano talaga ang nangyari!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: SONIC!!
targetText: SONIC!!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Someone murdered my darling Sonic!
targetText: May pumatay sa mahal kong si Sonic!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Looks like the game’s begun. I’m finding out who did this, at once!
targetText: Mukhang nagsimula na ang laro. Aalamin ko agad kung sino ang gumawa nito!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Amy, wait! I wanna figure out who did this too!
targetText: Amy, teka! Gusto ko ring alamin kung sino ang gumawa nito!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Is he actually hurt?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Nasaktan ba talaga siya?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(He’s… not moving…are these wounds on him genuine?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Hindi siya… gumagalaw… totoo ba ang mga sugat niya?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(My hand’s on his wrist but I don’t sense a pulse… am I doing this right? What in the world is going on?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Nasa pulso niya ang kamay ko pero wala akong maramdamang pulso… tama ba ang ginagawa ko? Ano ba ang nangyayari?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: These guests are incredibly renowned, which means they must be remarkably rich.
targetText: Napakakilala ng mga bisitang ito, ibig sabihin ay napakayaman nila.
speaker: Conductor

sourceText: So I leave their care to you,
targetText: Kaya ipinauubaya ko sa iyo ang pag-aalaga sa kanila,
speaker: Conductor

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I need to catch up to Amy and Tails and get to the bottom of this. Even if this is part of the game, I just can’t risk it.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kailangan kong habulin sina Amy at Tails at alamin ang katotohanan. Kahit bahagi ito ng laro, hindi ko ito maaaring isapalaran.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I’ll keep everyone safe Conductor, you’ll see.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Pananatilihin kong ligtas ang lahat, Konduktor—makikita mo.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Hnng… a bunch of evidence has fallen out of my pockets…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Hnng… maraming ebidensiya ang nalaglag mula sa mga bulsa ko…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Ugh… ah…
targetText: Aray… ah…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: My head… Tails? Amy? Ah…
targetText: Ang ulo ko… Tails? Amy? Ah…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: …! S-Sonic! I’m so sorry, uh, are you ok?
targetText: …! S-Sonic! Pasensya na, um, ayos ka lang ba?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Hangin’ in there. It seems the train arms threw us back into the dining car.
targetText: Kinakaya ko. Mukhang inihagis tayo pabalik sa bagon-kainan ng mga mekanikal na braso ng tren.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: …but where’s everyone else?
targetText: …pero nasaan ang iba?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Sonic The Hedgehog, asking about me??)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Si Sonic The Hedgehog, nagtatanong tungkol sa akin??)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I'M DOING AMAZING
targetText: SOBRANG GANDA NG PAKIRAMDAM KO

sourceText: I feel terrible
targetText: Napakasama ng pakiramdam ko

sourceText: Wow, amazing huh?
targetText: Wow, napakaganda ng pakiramdam mo, ha?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: You might have to share a bit of that enthusiasm with me!
targetText: Baka kailangan mong ibahagi sa akin ang kaunti ng sigasig na iyan!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I uh, might have overcompensated there…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Sobra yata akong bumawi roon…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Yeah… things aren’t looking the brightest.
targetText: Oo… mukhang madilim ang kalagayan natin.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: But when the situation’s dark, it’s up to us to shine the way forward.
targetText: Pero kapag madilim ang sitwasyon, nasa atin ang magbigay-liwanag sa daan pasulong.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… Sonic’s just as cool as everyone says…!)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ah… kasing-cool ni Sonic ang sabi ng lahat…!)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: While I’ve been out, what’s happened on this train?
targetText: Habang wala ako, ano ang nangyari sa tren na ito?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Get comfy, this may take a minute…
targetText: Umayos ka ng upo; baka matagalan ito nang kaunti…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Wow, sounds like I missed a party!
targetText: Wow, mukhang namiss ko ang party!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: What should I be looking for?
targetText: Ano ang dapat kong hanapin?

sourceText: …you’ve carried that around with you this whole time?
targetText: …dala-dala mo iyan sa buong panahong ito?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: If I ask for it, will you make me something on this list?
targetText: Kung hihingin ko, gagawan mo ba ako ng anuman sa listahang ito?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: I miss when it was just showing us the weather.
targetText: Namimiss ko noong ipinapakita lang nito sa atin ang panahon.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: … I miss the yellow glow already.
targetText: …Namimiss ko na ang dilaw na liwanag.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: You got some nerve showing up here, Egghead.
targetText: Ang kapal ng mukha mong magpakita rito, Egghead.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Hohoho, you spikey blue pest! Seems you’ve finally taken passage on one of my passenger trains.
targetText: Hohoho, ikaw na peste na asul ang tinik! Mukhang nakasakay ka na sa isa sa mga pampasaherong tren ko.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… ignoring that…)</style> They certainly didn’t talk about you in my interview!
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ah… hindi pinapansin iyon…)</style> Siguradong hindi ka nila binanggit sa interview ko!
speaker: Barry

sourceText: My involvement isn’t well known, civilian.
targetText: Hindi alam ng marami ang pagkakasangkot ko, sibilyan.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: The infrastructure in your towns just wasn’t cutting it. If I were to build Eggmanland, these problems would need sorting out!
targetText: Hindi sapat ang imprastraktura sa mga bayan ninyo. Kung magtatayo ako ng Eggmanland, kailangang lutasin ang mga problemang ito!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: So, I courageously got involved!
targetText: Kaya buong tapang akong nakialam!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: I converted some cargo trains into passenger trains for the sake of the public… it’s just more useful for future schemes.
targetText: Ginawa kong mga pampasaherong tren ang ilang tren ng kargamento para sa kapakanan ng publiko… mas kapaki-pakinabang lang ito para sa mga pakana ko sa hinaharap.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: Let me guess… Another death egg, Doctor Predictable?
targetText: Hayaan mong hulaan ko… Isa na namang Death Egg, Dr. Mahuhulaan?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Judging by my security cameras, your pathetic friends are all locked in the cars they were stationed in.
targetText: Ayon sa mga security camera ko, nakakulong ang mga kaawa-awa mong kaibigan sa mga bagon kung saan sila nakatalaga.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: You see, the capability of a badnik is normally very basic, just kill Sonic The Hedgehog.
targetText: Alam mo, karaniwang napakasimple ng kakayahan ng badnik: patayin lang si Sonic The Hedgehog.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: But for a luxury train, I wanted to be sure things ran without my supervision. And report to me if any of you happened aboard.
targetText: Pero para sa isang luxury train, gusto kong matiyak na maayos ang takbo ng lahat kahit wala ang aking pangangasiwa—at na mag-uulat ito sa akin kung sakaling sumakay ang sinuman sa inyo.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: This train’s capability of intellectual thought is extraordinary! A feat only accomplished by my genius!
targetText: Pambihira ang kakayahan ng tren na ito na mag-isip! Isang tagumpay na tanging isang henyo tulad ko ang makagagawa!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: <style=Thought>(So this confirms it… the train really is sentient.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kaya kumpirmado na… tunay ngang may kamalayan ang tren.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: See I got to thinking… I needed to manufacture motivation beyond programming.
targetText: Alam mo, napaisip ako… kailangan kong bigyan ito ng motibasyong higit pa sa programming.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: I like to make my badniks compete against one another from time to time. It’s good for productivity.
targetText: Gusto kong pagpaligsahin ang mga badnik ko paminsan-minsan. Mabuti iyon para sa pagiging produktibo.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: So I instituted a <style=Important>bounty</style> upon my army of badniks!
targetText: Kaya nagtakda ako ng <style=Important>pabuya</style> para sa hukbo ko ng mga badnik!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: First to capture you pathetic creatures gets <style=Important>a generous reward</style>!
targetText: Ang unang makahuli sa inyong mga kaawa-awang nilalang ay makakakuha ng <style=Important>malaking gantimpala</style>!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: Most of my robots ask for something simple like my autograph or whatever, but a highly intelligent train…
targetText: Karamihan sa mga robot ko ay humihingi ng simpleng bagay gaya ng autograph ko o kung ano man, pero isang tren na napakatalino…
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: It may ask for something more… interesting.
targetText: Baka humingi ito ng mas… kawili-wiling bagay.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: As much as I like reward programs, are you done blabbering, Doc?
targetText: Gustuhin ko man ang reward program, tapos ka na bang magdaldal, Dok?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: You can never just win silently, can you?
targetText: Hindi ka ba puwedeng manalo nang tahimik?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: When you’re dragged to my base you’ll regret the day you ever crossed me, hedgehog.
targetText: Kapag kinaladkad ka sa base ko, pagsisisihan mo ang araw na kinalaban mo ako, hedgehog.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: I already do. Get lost.
targetText: Nagsisisi na ako. Lumayas ka.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: …he always knows how to get under my skin.
targetText: …lagi niyang alam kung paano ako inisin.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: This is tough… the train has the motivation, and being made by Eggman, it’s no doubt powerful.
targetText: Mahirap ito… may motibo ang tren, at dahil ginawa ito ni Eggman, walang duda na makapangyarihan ito.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Not to mention, we’re all separated…
targetText: Bukod pa roon, magkakahiwalay tayong lahat…
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Sonic was really hurt… the conductor’s been captured…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Talagang nasaktan si Sonic… nahuli ang konduktor…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Should I have been more assertive earlier…?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Dapat ba mas iginiit ko ang sarili ko kanina…?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: But when negative thoughts hit you, let it pass, and keep living.
targetText: Pero kapag dumarating ang mga negatibong kaisipan, hayaan mo lang silang lumipas at magpatuloy sa buhay.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: I need you here helping me think through this, before I do something rash.
targetText: Kailangan kitang narito para tulungan akong pag-isipan ito bago ako gumawa ng anumang padalus-dalos.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: See, I’m one of those ‘leap before you think’ kinda guys.
targetText: Kita mo, isa akong tipong ‘kilos muna bago mag-isip.’
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Haha… ok. You’re right.
targetText: Haha… sige. Tama ka.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Well, I’d speed through head on, and rescue our friends! By any means necessary!
targetText: Kung gayon, didiretso ako nang mabilis at ililigtas ang mga kaibigan natin! Sa anumang kinakailangang paraan!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Here, stand back!
targetText: Sige, umatras ka!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Wow…! With one big wind up, Sonic's spindash was fast enough to get the door open!)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Wow…! Sa isang malaking ikot, sapat ang bilis ng spindash ni Sonic para mabuksan ang pinto!)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I get it. Well, let me know when you're ready!
targetText: Naiintindihan ko. Sabihin mo kapag handa ka na!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: That's the spirit! Let's go find our friends!
targetText: Iyan ang gusto kong marinig! Hanapin natin ang mga kaibigan natin!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: To the conductor car, to end this mystery!
targetText: Sa bagon ng konduktor, para tapusin ang misteryong ito!
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Aw man!
targetText: Ay, naku!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Amy was saying the train’s sights couldn’t be beat! I was excited!
targetText: Sabi ni Amy, walang makapapantay sa tanawin mula sa tren! Nasasabik ako!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Ah, what a mess in here…
targetText: Ah, ang gulo rito…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: With the robot arms going rogue, I wonder who will have to pick all this up…
targetText: Ngayong nagwala ang mga brasong robot, nagtataka ako kung sino ang kailangang magligpit ng lahat ng ito…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Look at all this salt that’s spilled, no wonder you’re having bad luck.
targetText: Tingnan mo ang natapong asin, hindi nakapagtatakang minamalas ka.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Quick, pick some up and toss it over your shoulder.
targetText: Bilisan mo, pumulot ka ng kaunti at ihagis iyon sa likod mo, lampas sa balikat.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: O-ok! <style=Thought>(A pinch of salt and… there, over the shoulder.)</style>
targetText: O-okay! <style=Thought>(Kaunting asin at… ayan, sa likod, lampas sa balikat.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Perfect, I can already tell our luck is turning around.
targetText: Perpekto, ramdam ko nang bumabalik ang suwerte natin.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: …? What was his ticket doing here?
targetText: …? Ano ang ginagawa rito ng tiket niya?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Maybe he confused a napkin for his ticket, and his ticket for a napkin?
targetText: Baka napagkamalan niya ang napkin na tiket niya, at ang tiket niya na napkin?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: HA, hope his ticket didn’t have a ketchup stain.
targetText: HA, sana walang mantsa ng ketchup ang tiket niya.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: …! Hey, one of those robotic arms are here too–
targetText: …! Hoy, narito rin ang isa sa mga mekanikal na braso–
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Yow! It swiped at me!)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Aray! Sinugod ako nito!)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Best to leave it alone. The train’s definitely mad at us.
targetText: Mas mabuting iwanan natin ito. Talagang galit sa atin ang tren.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Good call. <style=Thought>(We gotta get out of here before that arm swipes at us again…)</style>
targetText: Tamang desisyon. <style=Thought>(Kailangan nating umalis bago tayo muling sunggaban ng brasong iyon…)</style>
speaker: Barry
